rejected_rule.statement: A party claiming a share of land left unallotted after partition must be given a fair opportunity to establish their right, and the court must investigate the title of all parties involved.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In this case, the unallotted 1/3rd share was not claimed by anyone other than the 5th Defendant, when the unallotted 1/3rd share is claimed by the same party, it is the duty of the court to notice all the parties to the case and hold an inquiry into the claim.
